coaching.headline: Repeat deaths decided it: Scarlett died nine times, The Fey seven, and the team won zero of eight fights.

flags.text: Scarlett's nine deaths doubled the damn norm: four to Eden, three to Kaelen, two to Boris.
Scarlett at support made a second diver beside Khaimera, leaving nobody with Murdock; both shapes won 48.8%.
Kaelen killed Scarlett twice and Khaimera once outside any detected fight, and enemy Mini Prime followed.
Gideon took four of five kills off The Fey and finished 5/1/5 against a zero-kill allied midlaner.

focus.title: Stop the duo and mid bleeding
focus.action: Draft a peeling support like Steel or Aurora, never a second diver. After the first duo-lane death, support and carry move together, and The Fey trades with Gideon only with follow-up.

7.7.call: Enemy Fangtooth fell first, then Gideon killed Khaimera and Boris killed The Fey and Scarlett, lost 0-3. With Fangtooth already gone, back off and hold towers instead of fighting on.

9.1.call: Lost 1-4: Khaimera killed Gideon, then Eden killed The Fey and Khaimera, Kaelen killed Scarlett on the mid lane, and Greystone killed Aurora before destroying the offlane outer. After a kill, reset instead of extending the fight.

13.8.call: Lost 1-3: Eden killed Scarlett and Khaimera before the enemy Fangtooth, with Khaimera's kill on Kaelen and Gideon's kill on The Fey in the same window. Two allies down means conceding Fangtooth and holding the duo inner.

2d772a76-392a-4e6b-aa2a-17643915291d: Nine deaths, the game's most, four before minute ten. When Eden and Kaelen both show in the duo lane, back off toward the tower instead of trading.
Three wards placed against Kaelen's six, with Leafsong raising the ward cap to three. Before every Fangtooth, keep all three wards down around the pit.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: 263 hero damage per minute against an 835 norm, and 3.6 CS per minute against 7.4. When trading with Eden, place Static Trap first and fight inside the root.
Zero kill or death credit across all eight detected fights. When Khaimera commits to a fight nearby, fire Long Arm of the Law: unlimited range, ignores all physical armor.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: One death all game, to Greystone, and Greystone took the offlane outer tower soon after. When Greystone leaps in, hold Cryoseism until the leap lands.
3245 healing and 5813 mitigated, but 319 hero damage per minute on a 526 norm with one assist. When Khaimera engages, drop Hoarfrost's root on the same target.
b2f6ff63-0e68-4905-9ff7-1bed72c9ff1f: Seven deaths and zero kills, with Boris adding two more on top of Gideon's work. When Gideon's Black Hole is ready, stay outside the pull and poke from range.
8911 hero damage led the allied side, yet two assists were the only kill credit. Land Fly Trap on heroes Khaimera is already hitting so the damage finishes kills.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Every allied kill, first blood included: the whole damn offense. When Boris dies early again, call the team onto the next river buff while Boris respawns.
Six deaths and zero assists, two apiece to Eden and Kaelen. If Eden and Kaelen are unseen, skip the next contest and farm the far jungle.
Two wards placed against a 4.6 norm, zero cleared. If sentry was equipped, sweep the Fangtooth pit before the team groups there.

matchup: Duo was Scarlett and Murdock against Eden and Kaelen; the allied duo died five times before minute ten, the enemy duo zero.
Kaelen's Rimefang stuns, and Winter's Pursuit roots heroes carrying Frostbite.
build: Sky Splitter, the only finished item, deals a share of the target's current health on hit.
No armor item against a four-physical enemy comp, with Eden's 21252 hero damage the game's highest.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a hero below 30% health.
Natural Resistance cleanses crowd control at low health; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a dash such as First Intent.
The field holds no Scarlett support data, so no Eternal ranks here.
augment: Volcaic Slam: Empowered Cindara leaves a delayed eruption, damaging and slowing enemies.
Ashen Vow's outer edge on a hero empowers Cindara, so the slam follows a landed Ashen Vow.
crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush speeds nearby allies and makes allies immune to slows briefly.
improvement: An armor item second is the build test into four physical damage dealers, giving up Sky Splitter-path damage.
No Eternal or augment swap is proven without Scarlett support field data.

matchup: Duo opponents were Eden and Kaelen; Eden destroyed both the duo outer and duo inner towers.
Eden's Zero Shift swaps stances, and the melee stance heals from damage dealt to heroes.
build: Lightning Hawk belongs to the 55.9% winning core; Vanquisher and Imperator never finished.
Lightning Hawk's Chilling Momentum empowers a basic attack at full stacks, adding damage and a brief slow.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero.
Xyris, Weald and Vermis are a toss-up in the Murdock carry field; Xyris has the best odds.
Serration with Melting Point is the best Vermis pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Justice's Reach makes Shots Fired pierce units and adds range.
Justice's Reach leans ahead in the Murdock carry field. Sound keep.
crest: The recorded crest is the unevolved Sharpshooter Crest; evolving needs restored health, then a base trip.
Pacifier, a Sharpshooter Crest evolution, is clearly the field's best Murdock carry crest.
improvement: Evolve into Pacifier: a dash and empowered physical hit, recastable after a quick hero kill.
Testing Xyris over Vermis trades third-hit max-health damage for bonus damage growing with units killed.

matchup: Greystone was the lane opponent, finishing 2/0 with 3464 objective damage.
Greystone's Make Way shreds physical armor in stacks, and Stone Forged Soul restores more health at low health.
build: Magnify belongs to the 60.2% winning core; Elafrost and Flux Matrix never finished.
Magnify's Shredding Spells reduces magical armor in stacks, adding to Hypothermia's armor shred.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health and size as levels rise.
Vesh and Krix are a toss-up in the Aurora offlane field; Vesh has the best odds.
Voracity with Feeding Frenzy is the best Krix pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Hypothermia: Boreal Sweep hits on heroes shred both armors and slow attack speed.
Frozen Fury, Hypothermia and Glacial Thorns are a toss-up; Frozen Fury has the best odds.
crest: Tempest's Overcharge damages up to three nearby heroes every second and heals from the damage.
Winter's Fury leans ahead of Typhoon in the Aurora offlane field; Tempest ranks third.
Tempest, Winter's Fury and Typhoon evolve from Warlock Crest.
improvement: Winter's Fury over Tempest swaps the self-heal for a slowing zone making enemies take more magical damage.
No Eternal swap is proven: Vesh over Krix is a toss-up.

matchup: Gideon was the lane opponent, finishing 5/1/5 with 10526 hero damage, second on the enemy side; Khaimera scored the lone Gideon death.
Gideon's Black Hole pulls nearby enemies inward, and the passive tether ends in a root.
build: Orb Of Growth, the only finished item, earns bonus XP and evolves after a base trip once full.
Combustion, Wraith Leggings and Megacosm, the 53.7% winning core, never finished.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health; Voracity restores health on unit kills, and Cannibalism adds health per takedown.
Krix has too few The Fey midlane games to rank; Lotus and Aion are a toss-up, Lotus with the best odds.
augment: Verdant Embrace makes Untamed Growth heal the caster and allies, repeating on the explosion.
Verdant Embrace has too few games to lead; Natural Infusion leans ahead of Wild Growth.
crest: The recorded crest is the unevolved Wizard Crest; evolving needs restored mana, then a base trip.
Soulbearer and Epoch are a toss-up in The Fey midlane field; Soulbearer has the best odds.
Soulbearer and Epoch evolve from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Lotus over Krix is the test the field supports, trading bonus maximum health for random gains every takedown.
Evolve into Soulbearer for a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.

matchup: Boris was the jungle opponent; Khaimera killed Boris twice early, and Boris never killed Khaimera.
Kaelen's Frostfall cleanses before the leap and roots enemies caught in the center.
build: Overlord, the only finished item, cleaves around the target and gains permanent health from every enemy unit kill.
Basilisk and Rapture, the rest of the 56.4% winning core, never finished.
eternal: Knell's Rust stacks shred both armors on hero hits and return part of the shred as armor.
Lotus is clearly the field's best Khaimera jungle Eternal; Knell has too few games to lead.
Frequency with Fracture is the most-picked Knell pair; the run used Frequency with Peal.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Feral Ambush and Jungle Invasion are a toss-up; Feral Ambush has the best odds.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver damages around Khaimera and heals on hero hits.
Eviscerator is clearly the field's best Khaimera jungle crest; Judgement ranks third of three with enough games.
Eviscerator evolves from Sharpshooter Crest, Judgement from Champion Crest.
improvement: Lotus over Knell is the field-backed swap, giving up armor shred for random stat gains each takedown.
Eviscerator over Judgement trades the area heal for attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basic attacks.

threats: Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar
